title: elaphandra lucidula
intro: Elaphandra lucidula, commonly known as the "Mountain Angelica", is a plant species native to the Andean region of South America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Elaphandra lucidula include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
